facts.F1: ADO Story #6364 S03f Platform composition root, feature B (the move): the key ring and secret custody live in Platform/Encryption (B1); database management, demo data, the seeder port and the race-tolerant save live in Platform/ (B2); usage data, logging and releases live in Platform/ (B3); the dispatcher and its contracts, the clock and the host facilities live in Platform/ (B4); the update queue's mechanics live in Platform/UpdateQueue while the pipelines stay (B5). facts.F10: Pure moves of the platform production types measured in feature A's membership map into Platform/<Area> (Encryption, DatabaseManagement, DemoData, Seeding, Persistence, UsageData, Logging, Releases, DomainEvents, Host, UpdateQueue; namespace equal to folder), the unit tests of the moved types into Tests/Platform/<Area>, and the usings, rule and list strings, test-time budget keys, HostUsersStillToMove entries, test paths and GlobalSuppressions.cs targets that follow; behaviour unchanged.
facts.F11: The platform lane's own rules and the unit-test placement rule (feature C); the membership map, the preservation law, the GitHub classifier and platform-answers-compare (feature A, delivered); Data and its migrations, every repository with IRepository<T> and RepositoryBase<T>, the seven context seeders, the update pipelines (TeamUpdater, PortfolioUpdater, UpdateServiceBase<T> and their interfaces), the domain-event handlers, the host band (Startup, Health, Configuration, Standalone, Cache, Extensions, Factories), TestData zip fixtures and the Models entity and wire types (they stay); legalising the dispatcher contracts and clock by namespace for every module (own Story); any schema, configuration, signature or behaviour change; mutation and the finalize checklist (run after feature C, not nwdes slices). facts.F12: The moves build on feature A's subject-aware preservation law with PlatformLanePatternRoles: Context patterns widen by whole Platform area, Place patterns gain nothing (maintainer 2026-11-22).
